body:
## What to build

Reject a locally detectable error at the start of a Grouping specification before acquiring typed backend metadata, even when a later independent selection needs column types. Preserve the original selection condition and its precedence without evaluating the later selector.

On main snapshot `339315c387f31deace77566f5d3294b15b323865`, inspect a DuckDB table with one integer column x. A Grouping set selecting absent followed by x fails with the expected missing-column condition and sends no query. Changing only the second selection to a numeric type predicate sends a zero-row input query before the same missing-column condition. A temporary trace of the DBI query method confirmed the invocation; this was not inferred from a Sent query record. The later predicate itself was never evaluated.

On an otherwise supported derived dtplyr input whose types cannot safely be determined without source work, that same change hides the missing-column condition behind the metadata refusal and asks the caller to collect the input. The first error is decidable from the locally available column names, so neither the query nor that remediation is needed. ADR 0005 requires this error to precede backend metadata acquisition.

Closed #342 improved classification of entirely names-only selections. This finding concerns an independently invalid leading selection in a mixed names/type-dependent specification.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preserve the original condition for the demonstrated missing-column and invalid leading-selection expressions before typed metadata acquisition.
- [ ] Cover mixed selections within a Grouping set and across nested grouping families, through inspection and the affected Margin verbs.
- [ ] Prove that the DuckDB failure invokes no input metadata query and that the dtplyr failure reports the original selection error without asking for collection.
- [ ] Do not execute later predicates, force arbitrary caller bindings, or change valid selection evaluation order to perform the preflight.
- [ ] Preserve valid typed selections, the existing metadata/query policy, and lazy construction; add focused public-interface regressions and pass the Package-affecting Review-ready check.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Investigation evidence

[Dated investigation, minimized reproduction and executable replay evidence](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/1adc767d37bf97288b8a00da16f0ae8cc027c4f8/investigation/summary-grouping-total-share-bughunt-2026-10-31.md#f1-a-typed-sibling-disabled-leading-names-only-error-preflight). Recorded in PR #1098, which contains investigation material only.
title: [P2] Reject leading names-only Grouping errors before typed metadata acquisition
